name: insta-pending-snapshot-blocks-inline-fix
description: After an inline fabro_snapshot/assert_snapshot test fails once, insta writes a pending snapshot; fixing the inline literal is not enough while a stale pending exists — the test keeps failing against the OLD text. Fix: cargo insta reject --snapshot '<file>:<line>', then touch the test file to force a rebuild (nextest may re-run a stale binary otherwise), then re-run.
